summary.result: Finally, filling with voids in high-calcium quicklime(CaO) may result in the reduction of coefficient of permeability.
summary.background: The permeability of converter slag, replacing material of sand mat on improving soft clay foundation, was evaluated in the laboratory as well as in situ test.
